scheme_name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Power Tiller
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a farmer.
The beneficiary must be engaged in agricultural activities.
The beneficiary must be interested in availing a loan for purchasing a power tiller.
The beneficiary must intend to use the loan specifically for purchasing a power tiller.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan covering up to 90% of the power tiller cost at an interest rate of 11%–12.25%.
